name: Hirosoma Rokushou
source:
[Url=https://vndb.org/c105008]Kikyou's[/url] and [Url=https://vndb.org/c105012]Shinku's[/url] uncle, who was always nice, brought them candy and let them play games on his phone. 
[Spoiler]Later revealed to be their good-for-nothing father, who came onto [Url=https://vndb.org/c105008]Kikyou[/url] and [Url=https://vndb.org/c105012]Shinku[/url]. [Url=https://vndb.org/c105012]Shinku[/url] let him have her to protect [Url=https://vndb.org/c105008]Kikyou[/url] and her memories of their 'uncle'.[/spoiler]
